question: Can an orthogonal, fully causal market-context gate distinguish real daily altcoin K1->K2 launches from local false breakouts while preserving V2 execution and right-tail trend capture?
single_variable_contract: Only entry eligibility changes. Five context thresholds are screened sequentially, one coordinate at a time. EMA13/SMA34 morphology, neutral episode, K1/K2 distance, next-day-open entry, two-close failure, 2ATR disaster stop, 20% gradual bank, SMA34 runner, 90-day horizon, 20bp cost, position risk and concurrency are immutable.

design.development: The previously opened 52-symbol parent universe through 2026-04 is explicitly development-only and cannot provide new confirmation.
design.confirmation_a: 109 symbols that never appeared in V1/V2, blocked by early-archive availability and assigned by a seeded hash before any price outcome is opened.
design.sealed_confirmation_b: 108 disjoint symbols remain unopened. They may be opened only after a separate committed decision, and V3 permits it only if confirmation A passes every registered gate.
design.independent_unit: symbol is the cross-universe unit; entry week is the dependence cluster for return permutation
design.control: same-symbol, same-half-year, copied-direction, ATR-quintile random entry with identical execution, risk and 20bp cost

causal_feature_contract.breadth: Directional fraction of available altcoins whose completed close, EMA13/SMA34 spread and EMA13 three-day slope all agree; plus the five-completed-day change.
causal_feature_contract.major_regime: BTC and ETH completed-day EMA13/SMA34 alignment plus direction-adjusted 20-day return scaled by contemporaneous ATR.
causal_feature_contract.relative_strength: Direction-adjusted same-day cross-sectional percentiles of trailing 20-day return and path efficiency.
causal_feature_contract.availability: Every value is fixed at K2 day close; trade entry is next complete UTC day open. No future bar, outcome, listing after the source file's available history, or sealed-B price is used.

decision_rule: Confirmation A is a one-shot transport test. Failure leaves V3 rejected and keeps B sealed. Passing A does not imply production eligibility; it only authorizes a separately committed B audit under the unchanged frozen configuration.
known_biases: The instrument membership snapshot was frozen in September 2026 and therefore creates current-listing/survivorship bias even though no post-holdout OHLCV is read.
Some disjoint symbols have an archived 2021-2023 segment and a current 2025-2026 segment separated by a gap; indicators reset at every gap.
The development hypotheses were motivated by already viewed V1/V2 failures, so development metrics are exploratory by construction.
